subject.title:
WebChat Markdown rendering breaks for Japanese/CJK: (1) `**bold**` fails at punctuation boundaries, (2) `
` shown literally

question:
Should WebChat support literal `
` as a narrow sanitized line-break token, or keep all user-authored raw HTML escaped and document the table-cell limitation?
rationale:
The CJK emphasis fix is straightforward, but `
` support crosses the raw-HTML/XSS boundary that current code intentionally escapes.

options.title:
Allow only sanitized `
`
options.body:
Permit `
` through a tiny explicit renderer/sanitizer path while keeping every other raw HTML tag escaped, and test table-cell line breaks plus script/tag escaping.

options.title: Fix CJK and document no raw HTML
options.body:
Add the CJK-friendly parser behavior but keep `
` escaped, documenting that multiline table cells need non-HTML layouts.

options.title: Defer raw-HTML policy
options.body:
Keep the issue open for broader Markdown rendering policy if maintainers do not want a one-off `
` exception.

recommendation.title:
Allow only sanitized `
`
recommendation.body:

` through a tiny explicit renderer/sanitizer path while keeping every other raw HTML tag escaped, and test table-cell line breaks plus script/tag escaping.
